algorithm: v4: sort DEV tasks by sha256(v4_seed:task); first floor(n/2) are tune, rest holdout
disclosures: task halves are the retained tripwires-v4 assignment; built from tb4-audit-v1 assignment task rows plus the v4 task_assignment key only; no trajectory, label or outcome was read for TW-P1 to choose or alter the split
TEST-split tasks are never listed or read; a task with several splits is not DEV

TW-P1 holdout means excluded from THIS patch's development and tuning only: the v3/v4 work saw DEV census labels and rule hits for all 22 tasks and scored the v4 holdout half once, so neither half is untouched or independent in the historical sense
source: retained tripwires-v4 task_assignment (same by-task halves as the v3/v4 lineage)
unit: task (group); every trial/membership of a task is in one half
